title: Double glass shelf 16-Inch Wall Mount with Gallery Rail Solid Brass Hardware Allied Brass
short_title: Double glass shelf 16-Inch Wall Mount with Gallery Rail
description:
Upgrade everyday storage with a 16-inch double glass shelf designed to keep toiletries organized while saving counter space. This wall mount glass shelf features two tiers of 3/8-inch thick tempered glass and a gallery rail to help keep items in place. Crafted with solid brass hardware and concealed screw mounting, it delivers a clean, coordinated look for transitional bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Double shelf design is an ideal use of space for bath essentials
- 3/8-inch thick tempered glass for strength and safety
- Gallery rail helps keep bottles and accessories secure
- Solid brass hardware for an enduring, premium feel
- Concealed screw mounting for a streamlined wall-mounted installation

Specs:
- Glass size (each shelf): 16 x 5 inches
- Overall: 16 in L x 8 in H x 5 in projection
- Weight capacity: 4 lb
- Material: Brass hardware with tempered glass shelves
- Mounting: Wall mount; installation hardware included
- Assembly: Not required
- Collection: Waverly Place collection (matching Waverly Place pieces available)
- Finish options: available in 28 designer finishes, including statement colors like Glokzin Teal, Venetian Bronze, Lavender, Mediterranean Blue, and Sea Foam Green
